figures.finding: Qatar taxes no salaries, wages or allowances; a self-employed person's Qatar-source business income is taxed at 10% of taxable income (a Qatari or GCC national's share is exempt).
figures.applies: Income Tax Law No. 24 of 2018 as amended by Law No. 11 of 2022.

sources.said: the provisions of the attached Income Tax Law shall not apply to the following: 1. Ministries and other governmental agencies, as well as public authorities and institutions. 2. The tax rate is 10% of the taxable income of the taxpayer during the tax year.

figures.finding: The tax year is normally the calendar year; a return is due within four months after the year ends.

value.returnDue: within four months after year end (30 April)

sources.said: Financial Year: The accounting period for which the project prepares its financial statements, which is the calendar year or twelve (12) consecutive months ending on the last day of any month except December, with the President’s authorization.

figures.finding: Fees for services performed wholly or partly in Qatar paid to a non-resident with no permanent establishment there, and royalties, bear a final 5% withholding on the gross amount, subject to treaties.
figures.applies: Non-residents without a permanent establishment in Qatar; a performer's or director's fee for work in Qatar is a service fee.

Subject to the provisions of tax agreements, a final withholding tax of 5% of the gross amount applies to royalties, interest, commissions, and payments for services performed wholly or partly in the state, and paid to non-residents for activities not related to a permanent establishment in the state, as specified by the Regulation.

Fees for services specified in Article (9/2) of the Law are subject to a five percent (5%) withholding tax on the total amount, without any cost deductions, if these services are wholly or partly performed in the State.

figures.finding: Qatar has not introduced VAT; its draft law and regulations had not been published by September 2026.
